pages.text: Formulae are alchemical recipes for creating potions, oils and bombs. $(br)Each formula lists the required ingredients and describes the type of base necessary to create the mixture.$(br)These formulae can be discovered in various chests throughout the world or obtained by trading with villagers. $(br)$(n)You must know the recipe in order to craft the concoction.$()
The recipes for $(l:tcots_witcher:concoctions/decoctions)decoctions$(/l) can be only found in $(n)Ancient Cities$().
